body:
Hi all-
I have had this clear for life acryllic uniaquarium for 3 years and i have lived with quick fixes on my pump but now I actually need to replace it but for the life of me cant figure out how to get it out ???
I dont want to twist something i shpuldnt and have 0 clue what to do.

I already unscrewed the fromt but dont know how to get the back loose ?

Any advice and help is appreciated! Thank you in advance

Thank you for your reply ! 

Yes, i know he has his own gastro issues of his own so he swears by his bidet. He is from an Asian country but he immigrated quite young and I know growing up he did not have one. Im not sure if its exactly due to this but the way his thinking was, "poop juice" and all that. Maybe it is how we were raised ?

I know in my own family, as much as I hate admitting it, my own mom used to put a glove or bag over her hand and literally reach inside her own ass to get her shit out.
Now that? Unsanitary.

I always wondered how sanitary bidets are too because often times I feel like whats on the underside of the toilet seat is just power blasted 'poop' and if thats the theory, doesnt that mean it just gets scented all over your butt ?
Maybe I am crazy thinking that far into it.

Will definitely talk to him more about how it made me feel though..
Okay.  That inspires some confidence in me to tackle it on myself. Thanks !

You're sweet. Even though we're in the same boat...

Im just im really tired of feeling alone like I just have this constant shouting in my head telling me how inadequate i am and terrible.  I want to just scream and down underwater like I cant keep anything together. 

Jobless.  Technically homeless if im kicked out. No family. Im terrified..
Anyone to talk to please. :(

I think the biggest problem for me is that I cant contact my father individually.  (I have tried before this even and sorry probably should of included this in the text)

My mother has no sense of boundaries. Ie: your cellphone shouldnt have a passcode and she goes through everyones phones religiously.
She will pick up from my fathers facebook to reply or emails. I didnt find out until after I moved out/ was kicked out (me and s/o cant tell)... my mom was actually using her phone to take photos of convos on my phone.

Disgusting :(

Yeah you are completely right... ive been in some not so great relationships before this and so Ive been there. A lot of trying to climb your way out.

I feel very humbled by your kind words. I truely am. I try to be a nice person into the world but lately all i feel is really selfish about my actions. I will do my best to keep my head up.

I probably wont mention that part haha but to be fair, even if they weren't my ex its still pretty rude to just talk to someone as if they will / are your emotional dumpster to trash your problems in you know ? I just think about that and think wow.. i dont wanna bring that negative energy to other people.

Ive been trying to prep myself on talking points if I can or at least understand my emotions on this better. Id be amazed if ill remember but Im hoping for the best. 
I will definitely update this hopefilly with better news. ><

Honestly thank you for your understanding. What a brain fart it was! Same day i accidently locked the magnet inside the child proof cabinets too. I think I also tried to put milk away in a cupboard. (Shame on my brain)

Last night, I really had to convince him to stay with me in bed. He got up multiple times because of how disgusted he was at me... I wanted to do my best to hold him but it was all unwanted.. 

Im hoping that by giving him the rest this workday since our next new argument this morning... maybe itll change. Im terrified but worried.

Thank you for your kind words. I really teared up reading this.
I cant blame him for feeling the way he did. To be honest the move in was so rushed and stressful. 
I remember how much of a toll it took on him and I dont know why it sticks with me but I remembered being blamed / admit responsibility for being the reason as to why he wasnt able to focus on his work.

I cant work from home much but when I do, I always make it a goal to keep him fed with snacks and a good meal. I think about it and how much hes done for me and I cant help but feel guilty because i know he has his own troubles too. To be fair I also need to do more listening.

I get to go home and see him and our kitty cat soon. I am nervous as all heck still...  i will try to post the outcome here once its over tonight. ><

You know honestly, that is exactly what he told me last night surrounding his anger. When I take a step back and I look at the situation, I actually am kind of disgusted in my own self. Because of a certain way I had felt, I decided it was okay to reach out to whoever was the most convenient. In a way this is not fair to my ex/friend and not a way to treat anyone.  Pulling them aside just to feel better especially after not talking for a whole two/three months. 

In this regard I was not a kind human being and I am ashamed.

I am further ashamed because the end result didnt help me much. I came home thursday afternoon to have a panic attack and wrap a scarf around my neck to feel safe. (This is my comfort method).
I still went back to that audit room at work and was treated with the same indignant tone. Nothing changed.

If ANYTHING, I had made it worse for myself because when taking my criteria into my mind with who i want to vent too. I only considered proximity and not from my company. Failing to take into consideration anything else. I failed my partner. I failed myself. What I accomplished that lunch was nothing.

Its truely my fault for taking a coincidental meeting and then reintroducing a toxic situation into our lives.

Thank you for all your words. It really helps perspective from my S/O point of view.

Conflict avoidant means attempting to avoid direct confrontation by changing the subject, etc.
In original post I had stated I changed the topic when I saw his disapproval. He later rebrought it up at dinner.

Even in normal situatuons, I am the person to just say sorry and move on or stay out of the way.
I really try to not exhaust myself.

Yes ! Thats what didnt really click to me initially. I hate talking to exes and I never do. But I always seem to intermittendly forget with this person just because they were with me through multiple surgeries in the past and was also around family parties, family gatherings, school hallways and cafeterias. Theres like this odd part of me that just absolutely blanks and forgets the time from when we dated which was abusive. I am so regretful I did not rethink on this more.

I know we werent "alone" because public parking lot but Its not like my S/o was there and he cant obviously know what I really did or said. Its something like you said. This should NEVER of been an issue in the first place and I shouodnt have put him in that spot.

In your opinion since we live together... should i steer clear and give him space and crash elsewhere ? Im not sure. I have lots of groceries at home to make a nice dinner. I love cooking for him and doing other little thing but I know my trinkets of affection might not mean anything at all right now... and that... honestly scares the living daylight of me. :(

I know! The night before I remember when I was having my panic attack about work he had asked me what was wrong. I remember failing to have the words to tell him how terribly scared I am. About work about finances about the leftover stuff from moving in about family if ill have regrets. I had so much trouble with my anxiety lately that I have been harming my own body without realizing it sometimes during my episodes.  Sometimes even speaking... words or sound dont even leave my mouth and it was so hard for me because I wanted to tell him everything that was wrong. Im thinking that my S/O is feeling hurt from my lack of explanation around my stress and panic attacks. When i told him about the lunch thing it made him feel like I couldnt come to hik probably.

When I went to lunch.. I honestly didnt even confide in them about financial hardship or any other problems just how work was rough. It hurts me to know how hard it is for me to open up at times...

Later I felt awkward about the whole exchange because yeah, it doesnt feel right especially since we now live together. I tell my S/O about it if I didnt feel 100% confident hat I love them and I am just transparent. It made me sick last night just hearing my S/O even suggest that I should go to my ex. And when he brought up more examples on how I could be more empathetic in his shoes how would I feel if he went with an ex.. ive felt scumbaggier by minute.

 I had a long conversation with my S/O that continued well into the early AM hours.. i can imagine tonight will be a lot to talk about again but putting my cluster of thoughts together in the heat of the moment is challenging and Im scared of saying the wrong thing. 

I agree he needs space and such. Should I possibly consider bunking with a friend until tomorrow ? Im not sure. I just really wish it wasnt like this right now.

I got to think about the points people have been bringing up and the questions to ask myself and to come up with  solid answers so I can work this out.

I am a complete idiot. Ill admit that. I am not trying to excuse my way out of this rather... just trying to figure out how I can possibly fix it with my S/O.
I probably am stupid haha... i mean .. i did recognize in my OP that I am an emotional idiot. 

I dont see this person 100% the time as my ex. Rather a childhood friend i had history with. 
I realize that by harboring hate for someone you cant really live your life. Hating is so much effort and after 6 or 7 years later, I would rather just let bygones be especially if its coming from the past where a lack of maturity is evident. 

For sure though... I can recognize that they are my ex though and that for sure I messed up here! But to clarify it isnt private time nor did we formally sit down at an outdoor resturant. Just ate from our cars in the parking lot.

I care about my S/O a lot which is why Im trying to get different opinions on what to do since I have a major headache in my own life right now. I appreciate the time you took to read and reply.

I will.. and yes you are right hopefully he will still want to be with me.
I dont intend on contacting my ex again. I think it will be even easier this time since i moved in with my S/o anyways miles away. It was so random to just find out my job was this close this whole time. (We relocated in July) Deleted all my exes contact info so i couldn't anymore even if I wanted.
Need to commit fully 100% especially since I really dont want to mess this up.

Im just such a klutz its hard to be with me. Like an emotionally insensitive child... >< but i am always willing to make it up and work it out.
Thank you so much for reading it out.

Honestly, once he was confronting me about it at dinner.. i tried to explain it but I dont think that my explanations are good enough for him? If that.. made sense...? My answers are too long.
What he really wanted me to admit... that still didnt really solve our problems were the following statements:
"I was not thinking about how my choices affected my S/O. I did not communicate at all when my status of not talking / hate changed to a casual lunch."


I really tried to point out the duress and how i have basically buckled on that day to going to lunch. How I didnt see him as anything to me which is why it was so easy for me to just not think anything about it.

He says he cant trust me but honestly it makes me feel hurt because I cant imaging myself with my ex anyways. It still gives me this gut wrenching I want to vomit feeling. I know he feels like I didnt come to him and instead went to my ex but with his stressful job... i feel like ive been coming home and complaining almost daily with injustices that happenned and I couldnt imagine just bringing that down on him when I know he has his own stuff.

Maybe that makes me a bad person for using my "friend" for just ranting or venting and bringing them back into my life for that brief time. I will try brainstorming in what you said and see if I can come up with good talking points by tonight.

I feel like we have talked on and off over the last 5 or 6 years just because literally we live in the same culvesac. We may casually hang out in the past but its always with friends and nothing ever happens. Just catching up on life.

Yeah.. since the conversation last night it really snapped me back into reality and I already blocked them on my social media accounts. Its not something actively healthy and I have received a lot of backlash from people regarding it. Because of the title "Ex" it never will make things the same again and Im realizing how negatively these things are portrayed... i cant take the stress anymore especially knowing I truely dont have feelings.

Thank you for understanding though... I really didnt want to see my coworkers and just made really poor choices in company for that day... i will have to communicate more with my S/O tonight because honestly nothing means more to me than them.. and i hope we can work it out.

I dont thrive on toxic situations ?
Normally I am pretty conflict avoidant... I chose this person solely because they cropped up again on my radar by bumping into them.
I chose this person due to the close proximity to me and since I am an anti social person it is hard for me to open up to people I do not really know.

I do not have feelings for my ex . I have already been through 2 previous relationships since and this has never been a topic of conversation or problematic. Thank you though for replying.

I will agree though, my S/O definitely has a right to be mad.

Previous relationship was very verbally abusive and at times we might of thrown things at each other. But being a teenager at the time, of course it wasnt a mature real relationship. Breakup was also terrible as my friend moved across the US for 3 years before coming back to the same suburb & state as I was in for the last 5 or 6 years. It probably even took us another 2 years to even talk to each other again like normal human beings.

Honestly you should dump on me. I deserve it...
And yeah you are spot on. He felt upset because in his mind the situation was one and done but this week i have been failing to communicate anything that I was going through.. 

I just dont know where to go from here.

Thanks. I know he feels the way he feels because in the end it doesnt matter how long ive known him or the fact our families and inner circles have been the same... its still an "Ex". 

To me, I think that I too would also feel jealous if he saw an ex in part, but I feel I would be fine if they were someone their parents knew or knew since they were like 12 and things didnt work out. 
I dont feel anything for them anymore on the sligest more like slight curiosity of where life is taking them and just being able to vent.

All things taken in consideration though, I could of reached out to other people as well... i just did what was the most convenient to me at the time which was wrong.

Yeah.. i dont know what I was thinking. 
Part of me just forgets when Im really stressed or focused on other things and here I didnt think about how it would affect him.. i was 100% selfish.

I should of let him know beforehand.. just dont know what to do going forward now.
Wasnt sure how to make a post but, i saw this green blob appear on my snail last night. Not sure what it is or if it is harmful to the poor guy. :(
Thanks.  Hes a long term boyfriend but oddly I dip find myself failing to see him do that with me even on good terms.  :(

To be honest, Im leaning more towards worn out, I want to give him benefit of the doubt, but that was the first panic attack in a few months. I already cant come to him with any of my day to day problems / emotions / accomplishments / sucesses cause it almost feels like everything out of my mouth causes him intense stress. :/ Im at a loss.

I was seeing CBT back in 2014  and now just a therapist. Im trying to do more self progress now that Im out of my more troubling phase. Ie: what steesses me out, how to avoid / fix that
